newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Oil Search reports oil bearing zones.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Oil Search reports oil bearing zones.

text.p: Oil Search Ltd said on Monday that tests had shown two oil bearing intervals in its Moran 1X/Sidetrack 4 exploration well onshore in Papua New Guinea.
Electric logs indicated that the Toro interval and the upper part of the Digimu sandstone were oil bearing, it said.
Hole conditions prevented the deeper sections of the Digimu sandstone being tested.
"It's confirmed that there's oil and shows the on-going potential of the region," said an analyst.
Oil Search surged to record highs last month when the oil and gas producer and explorer reported hydrocarbon shows and heightened resistivities at its Moran 1X/Sidetrack 3 well in permit PDL-2.
Monday's announcement came after the close of trade.
Shares in Oil Search ended three cents higher at A$2.26.
